_comment: Image slots. scripts/fetch-commons.mjs fills empty slots from Wikimedia Commons using 'commons' (or 'query'). 'require' = words that must appear in the photo's title/description (keeps city photos honest). Missing cities fall back to city-default. scripts/generate-fal.mjs generates the slots that have a 'fal' prompt (needs FAL_KEY) and replaces stock photos there; 'alt' is used as their alt text.
